message.content:
Sure! Those coordinates are already in latitude/longitude format, but if you want to confirm what they point to (or retrieve the full address, place name, etc.) you can use a reverse‑geocoding request with the Google Maps Geocoding API.

---

## 1. What the coordinates represent

**Latitude:** 37.4224764  
**Longitude:** –122.0842499  

These coordinates point to the **Googleplex** – Google’s headquarters in Mountain View, California.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Address | 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA |
| City | Mountain View |
| State | California |
| Country | United States |
| Postal Code | 94043 |

---

## 2. How to reverse‑geocode with the Google Geocoding API

If you want to programmatically retrieve the address (or other metadata) for these coordinates, you can make a GET request like this:

```
https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

### Example response snippet

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "address_components": [
        {"long_name":"1600","short_name":"1600","types":["street_number"]},
        {"long_name":"Amphitheatre Parkway","short_name":"Amphitheatre Pkwy","types":["route"]},
        {"long_name":"Mountain View","short_name":"Mountain View","types":["locality","political"]},
        {"long_name":"Santa Clara County","short_name":"Santa Clara County","types":["administrative_area_level_2","political"]},
        {"long_name":"California","short_name":"CA","types":["administrative_area_level_1","political"]},
        {"long_name":"United States","short_name":"US","types":["country","political"]},
        {"long_name":"94043","short_name":"94043","types":["postal_code"]}
      ],
      "formatted_address":"1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA",
      "geometry": {
        "location": {"lat":37.4224764,"lng":-122.0842499},
        "location_type":"ROOFTOP",
        "viewport":{...}
      },
      "place_id":"ChIJj61dQgK6j4AR4J7x5Z8Y5wI",
      "types":["street_address"]
    }
  ],
  "status":"OK"
}
```

---

## 3. Quick sanity check

If you paste the coordinates into Google Maps or any mapping service, you’ll see the Googleplex marker:

```
https://www.google.com/maps/@37.4224764,-122.0842499,17z
```

---

### TL;DR

- The coordinates **37.4224764, –122.0842499** point to the Googleplex in Mountain View, CA.
- Use the reverse‑geocoding endpoint above to fetch the full address or other place details programmatically.
